mapper.select: SELECT dsl.id, dsl.vessel_id, v.name AS vessel_name, dsl.company_id, c.name AS company_name, dsl.log_date, dsl.representative_name, dsl.attendees_count, dsl.training_content, dsl.scanned_file_url, dsl.kakao_message_id, dsl.received_via, dsl.created_at FROM tb_daily_safety_log dsl LEFT JOIN tb_vessel v ON v.id = dsl.vessel_id LEFT JOIN tb_company c ON c.id = dsl.company_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE dsl.id = #{id} AND dsl.deleted = 0

SELECT dsl.id, dsl.vessel_id, v.name AS vessel_name, dsl.company_id, c.name AS company_name, dsl.log_date, dsl.representative_name, dsl.attendees_count, dsl.training_content, dsl.scanned_file_url, dsl.kakao_message_id, dsl.received_via, dsl.created_at FROM tb_daily_safety_log dsl LEFT JOIN tb_vessel v ON v.id = dsl.vessel_id LEFT JOIN tb_company c ON c.id = dsl.company_id AND c.deleted = 0
ORDER BY dsl.log_date DESC, dsl.id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
